limitations: The universe is today's Nifty 50 members: stocks that survived and grew into the index. Every result on their past is flattered by that; there is no membership history to correct it.
Two years of 15-minute history were fetched. The research stretch is under nine months of one market's weather.
Spread and slippage are assumed (conservative scenario), not measured. No fill has ever been observed.
Positions are flat by the 15:00 bar's close; the live engine squares off 20 minutes before 15:30. Intraday leverage is not assumed: the account is sized at 1x.
Trades are sized against a fixed Rs 1,00,000 and do not compound.
Angel One's 15-minute history carries flat, zero-volume closing bars on some days (docs/research/ANGEL_ONE_DATA_QUALITY.md); VWAP uses volume, so those days are noisy.
Adjusted prices: a stock that has since split looks cheaper in its past than it was.

not_built.cross_sectional_momentum: Ranks stocks against each other at a timestamp; the per-stock Strategy interface cannot express it, and it needs a point-in-time universe the data does not have (the universe is today's index members).
not_built.daily_mean_reversion: Daily bars on delivery; a separate study (delivery costs and a different holding period), not started.

strategies.entry_rule: The first bar after the opening range (`or_bars` bars from 09:15) to close above its high (below its low), before 13:30: enter at the next open.
strategies.exit_rule: Stop at the far side of the range; target `rr` times that risk; out at the close of the 15:00 bar. One trade a day.
strategies.falsified_by: Net expectancy not above zero after costs, or no better than entries at random bars with the same stops, targets and holding times.
strategies.hypothesis: The first minutes of the session set a range; a close beyond it, the first of the day, starts a move that carries.
strategies.name: orb15

strategies.entry_rule: Close beyond the previous N bars' high (low), with yesterday's close above (below) the EMA(20) of daily closes: enter at the next open.
strategies.exit_rule: Stop k ATRs away, trailing k ATRs behind the best price; out at 15:15.
strategies.falsified_by: Net expectancy not above zero after costs, or no better than random entries taken in the same direction.
strategies.hypothesis: With the daily trend, a break of the last N bars' extreme continues further than it reverses.
strategies.name: trend15

strategies.entry_rule: Close beyond the previous N bars' high (low), with yesterday's close above (below) the EMA(20) of daily closes: enter at the next open. ATR/close must rank at or above the median of the last 500 bars.
strategies.exit_rule: Stop k ATRs away, trailing k ATRs behind the best price; out at 15:15.
strategies.falsified_by: Not better than `trend15` at the same N and k on the same stretch.
strategies.hypothesis: The same trend rule, taken only when volatility is above its own median of the last 500 bars: a predeclared filter, tested beside the unfiltered rule rather than chosen from it.
strategies.name: trend15_vol

strategies.entry_rule: The Supertrend direction changes at a bar's close (ADX(14) at least `adx_min`): enter at the next open.
strategies.exit_rule: Stop at the band's level at the flip; no target; out at 15:15.
strategies.falsified_by: Net expectancy not above zero after costs; or the ADX filter not improving it.
strategies.hypothesis: A close through the Supertrend band (ATR 10) flips the trend and the new direction persists.
strategies.name: supertrend15

strategies.entry_rule: At least 5 bars into the session, ADX(14) at most `adx_max`, close `z` ATRs below (above) session VWAP: enter long (short) at the next open.
strategies.exit_rule: Target the VWAP as it stood at the signal; stop 1.5 ATR beyond entry; out at 15:15.
strategies.falsified_by: Net expectancy not above zero after costs, or no better than random.
strategies.hypothesis: Away from a trend, price stretched `z` ATRs from the session VWAP returns to it.
strategies.name: vwap_reversion15

strategies.entry_rule: Band width in its lowest `pct` of the last 200 bars on the previous bar, and a close beyond the previous 20-bar extreme: enter at the next open.
strategies.exit_rule: Stop k ATRs away, trailing; out at 15:15.
strategies.falsified_by: Net expectancy not above zero after costs; not better than `channel15`.
strategies.hypothesis: A break out of an unusually narrow Bollinger band starts a move larger than the range before it.
strategies.name: bb_squeeze15

strategies.entry_rule: RSI(14) crosses up through `level` (down through 100 minus it) with the close above (below) its 50-bar EMA: enter at the next open.
strategies.exit_rule: Stop k ATRs away, trailing; out at 15:15.
strategies.falsified_by: Net expectancy not above zero after costs, or no better than random.
strategies.hypothesis: RSI(14) crossing up through a high level, above the 50-bar EMA, is momentum that persists — not an overbought reading to sell.
strategies.name: rsi_momentum15

strategies.entry_rule: Close beyond the previous N bars' extreme: enter at the next open.
strategies.exit_rule: Stop k ATRs away, trailing; out at 15:15.
strategies.falsified_by: Net expectancy not above zero after costs, or no better than random.
strategies.hypothesis: A close beyond the highest high (lowest low) of the last N bars — the window shifted so the bar's own extreme is not in it — continues.
strategies.name: channel15

strategies.entry_rule: Today's open at least `gap` away from yesterday's close, and the close of the second bar (09:30) on the gap's side of the open: enter at the next open.
strategies.exit_rule: Stop beyond the extreme of the first two bars; target `rr` times that risk; out at 15:15. One trade a day.
strategies.falsified_by: Net expectancy not above zero after costs, or no better than random.
strategies.hypothesis: A gap of at least `gap` that the first half hour confirms — price still on the gap's side of the open — keeps going.
strategies.name: gap_trend15

strategies.entry_rule: Gap at least `gap`, and at the close of bar `decide` (0 is 09:15, 1 is 09:30) price is back on the prior-close side of the open: enter against the gap at the next open.
strategies.exit_rule: Target yesterday's close; stop beyond the day's extreme so far; out at 15:15.
strategies.falsified_by: Net expectancy not above zero after costs, or no better than random; and not different from `gap_trend15` in the opposite direction.
strategies.hypothesis: A gap of at least `gap` whose first bars close back toward yesterday's close is being faded, and fills.
strategies.name: gap_reversal15
